signed quality, lot, reprocessing and plant acts over HTTP (slice 6a) > [IN-02] a deviation classified MINOR without a rationale is refused by the route and by the database

signed quality, lot, reprocessing and plant acts over HTTP (slice 6a) > a lot test result approval, the retest, and the lot release and rejection succeed through the ceremony and are refused for the wrong person or changed content

signed quality, lot, reprocessing and plant acts over HTTP (slice 6a) > the QC decision on extra testing of a batch succeeds through the ceremony and is refused for the wrong person or changed content

signed quality, lot, reprocessing and plant acts over HTTP (slice 6a) > the reprocessing acts sign nothing for a person without the quality unit's authority, for changed content, or when the database refuses the record

signed quality, lot, reprocessing and plant acts over HTTP (slice 6a) > plant verifications (cleaning, clearance, repair) succeed through the ceremony and are refused for the performer or changed content

specifications and results over HTTP (IN-33, PR-45) > [IN-33][PR-45] QC drafts a specification citing the pharmacopoeia and edition of every limit; only another person approves it (LIMS_ACT); a result takes its limits from it and the release check names the required test

lot status events over HTTP (D-P4-3) > [DI-37][IN-24] HOLD, UNHOLD, RETURN and RECALL are proposed by QA, then signed as LOT_DECISION over the content that names the proposal; a decision not proposed, another than the one proposed, or a proposal by the QC analyst is refused
finished lots, returned goods and samples over HTTP (IN-05 (a), PR-45, PR-48, PR-44, IN-32) > [IN-05][PR-45] a finished lot is posted only from a packaging order whose execution is complete

finished lots, returned goods and samples over HTTP (IN-05 (a), PR-45, PR-48, PR-44, IN-32) > [PR-48] returned goods are booked in quarantine, assessed and signed by QC (LIMS_ACT), and with doubt leave only by rejection; [PR-44][IN-32] a retention sample is pulled with its computed quantity and kept until expiry + 1 year

receipt routes (PR-17) > [PR-17] stores receive a delivery of three supplier batches as three lots; QA approves the manufacturer with its signature; the examined lot is free to issue and the unapproved one is blocked
receipt routes (PR-17) > [PR-17] a lot received without a receipt record gets one by route; its view refuses issue until then
